name: What is the typical timeframe to see results from AI Search Optimization efforts?
description: Initial AEO results can appear in 3-6 months, with more significant and sustained growth typically observed over 6-12 months, as it's an ongoing process.

mainEntity.name: What is the typical timeframe to see results from AI Search Optimization efforts?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeframe to observe significant results from AI Search Optimization can vary based on several factors, including the initial state of your online presence, industry competition, and the scope of implementation. Generally, businesses may start seeing initial improvements in visibility and engagement within 3 to 6 months. More substantial and sustained growth often develops over 6 to 12 months as AI systems learn and your content establishes authority in new search paradigms. AEO is an ongoing process.
